name: AbuseIPDB - Windows Logon from Blacklisted IP
description: Detects successful Windows network logon (Type 3) or RDP logon (Type 10) from an AbuseIPDB blacklisted IP with confidence score >= 75. Indicates direct compromise of on-premises infrastructure from known malicious sources.
query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 75
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventID == 4624
| where LogonType in (3, 10)
| where isnotempty(IpAddress)
| where IpAddress !in ('127.0.0.1', '::1', '-')
| where IpAddress in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on IpAddress
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, IpAddress, AbuseScore, Country, LogonTypeName, Process
| extend HostName = tostring(split(Computer, '.')[0])
